mechanism_summary: The near-parity of SCORE_BEFORE_LANE between false_positive_ruin and selected_winner is contaminated by two non-mutually-exclusive artifacts that the 27-case archaeology cannot separate: (a) a collider on is_b0_pick — every false_positive_ruin is is_b0_pick=true and every false_negative is is_b0_pick=false, so score distributions are truncated by the very lane whose work the score is supposed to evaluate; and (b) vol+mom feature dominance — the largest standardized deltas load on vol_ratio_5_20 and mom_20, so any pre-lane proxy built only from these features will mechanically compress to near-parity across error types. The researcher's residual-axis claim and the skeptic's collider claim both predict the same observation, so the observation cannot adjudicate between them.
falsifiers: Within either is_b0_pick stratum, the SlotA-vs-SlotC Hodges-Lehmann delta on the SCORE_BEFORE_LANE proxy exceeds 0.30 in absolute value — this would refute the collider explanation and shift weight toward the vol+mom residual-axis story.

Pooled-within-vol_ratio_5_20-quartile KS distance between SlotA and SlotC on the vol+mom-stripped residual falls below 0.10 — this would refute the residual-axis claim and leave the collider as the dominant explanation.

Sign-inconsistent block-level deltas across snapshot_anon blocks, or >50% of blocks containing only one slot — outcome UNRESOLVED on regime robustness, demanding either extended archaeology or a held-out pre-lane candidate pool.
actionable_design_principles: Do not treat SCORE_BEFORE_LANE parity as a causal claim about the score; gate any parity-based lane equivalence statement on a successful collider_cohort_stratification test with n>=30 per stratum per slot, and route base/pullback information into a separate post-lane residual score rather than collapsing it into a marginal pre-lane gate.

Run the three pre-registered tests (collider stratification, vol-quartile residualization, snapshot blocking) on the next 50 B0 picks with Holm-corrected alpha=0.10 before any policy change, and explicitly pre-specify the unconditioned pre-lane candidate pool comparison as the tie-breaker if stratum tests are inconclusive.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Add a SCORE_BEFORE_LANE_PARITY_AUDIT operator that requires is_b0_pick-stratified re-estimation of SlotA-vs-SlotC deltas before the score can be used as a marginal filter, and emits UNRESOLVED if either stratum has fewer than 30 cases.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Encodes the experimental designer's success/failure criteria directly into policy, making the collider check a first-class gate rather than a diagnostic run after the fact.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Prevents premature commitment to either the researcher's residual-axis mechanism or the skeptic's collider story by forcing an explicit stratum-level decision and refusing to act on underpowered parity claims.
